Saved. This question exposed three generalizable things now captured in the skill:

1. The CAGR + decay-factor + arc-elasticity COMBO pattern (multiple derived rates off the same two endpoints).
2. Key conventions: decay factor = 1 + CAGR (the per-year multiplier, <1 for declines); arc elasticity "via midpoint percentage change" in a single-series growth context = midpoint %Δ of value ÷ midpoint %Δ of time (years as X), which differs from the existing two-variable IRS arc-elasticity case.
3. The "include both budgetary and trust-fund flows" → all-funds agency grand-total outlay row distinction, plus the worked Labor FY2011→FY2019 example.

No memory update needed — this is procedural and fits the existing skill rather than being a durable cross-session fact. Done.
